d: EMBERFALL #3 — Cinderhold in Flames. midnight over the Vale Compact — and Syllmiria is already three steps ahead. Starring Syllmiria (Nesor Shador), Kaalmir (Robris Vedine), Phaxora (Johollow Rifell). In a valley of ash and frost, young wardens carry living ember-flames between the last warm holds of the Vale.
